objective.name: sandbox.dsl.remote.engine
objective.description: Cross-instance DSL flow invoking a remote engine-native reflexive capacity.

#root.role: Perform a local wrapper call, then invoke a remote engine-native state read directly through the external Brique boundary.

effects.local_wrapper_runtime: The local wrapper runtime is invoked.
effects.external_route: A remote engine-native reflexive route crosses the inter-instance boundary.

transformation_contract.morphing: A local DSL request becomes a remote engine-native state response after one local wrapper step and one direct inter-instance route.
invariants: The flow performs one local wrapper step before the remote engine-native call.
The terminal payload is the payload returned by the remote read.state call rather than by the local wrapper step.
Only one inter-instance engine-native subcall is issued.
success: On success, the terminal payload is the remote read.state payload reached through the external boundary.
Successful execution proves that local wrapper work can precede a direct remote engine-native terminal call.
failure: The flow fails if either the local wrapper pre-step or the remote engine-native call cannot complete.
Inter-instance routing errors close the capacity fail-closed.
notes: This scenario validates DSL orchestration that terminates on a remote engine-native response.
The initial local wrapper call is intentionally non-terminal and only proves preceding local composition.
